> @copilot 你完成个啥呀？样式都丢了，网站乱七八糟的。

Fixed in ee3af4a. The issue was incorrect Tailwind v4 configuration. fumadocs v16 requires Tailwind v4 with specific CSS imports.

**Changes made:**
- Added fumadocs-ui CSS imports to global.css
- Removed unused tailwind.config.ts (v4 uses CSS-first config)
- Verified build succeeds and styles render correctly
